$comment: Every {{TOKEN}} that may appear anywhere in drafts/**, ANNOTATIONS.md, FAQ-OSPO.md or decisions/** must be declared here. scripts/check-drafts.mjs fails the build on an undeclared token AND on a declared token nobody uses, so this file is the complete, auditable list of every token the draft texts use. Until 2026-09-08 that was the same thing as the list of everything not yet decided; a token whose constant has since been settled stays declared for as long as a text still writes it, and says so in its own `status`. Decision D10 (one canonical text, zero per-project parameters) means the SHIPPED text must resolve every token below to a literal constant — the tokens exist because the constants are not chosen yet, never because the text is meant to be filled in per project.

STEWARD_ORG_LEGAL_NAME.blockedBy: the commercial-register entry (LEG-060): D40 item 1 (2026-09-14) accepted the descriptive legal name for the Association and amended D4's coined-name rule for it; the token stays in the text until the entry exists and 1.0 is rendered for publication. Superseded: "D4 (coined steward-organization name, after a knock-out trademark search) + LEG-060 (the entity does not exist yet)"
STEWARD_ORG_LEGAL_NAME.meaning: Registered legal name of the Steward Organization, named in the licence text itself as a licence-wide constant (LEG-027).
STEWARD_ORG_LEGAL_NAME.note: Working prose calls it "the Steward Organization". The name must avoid the word "Open" entirely (D4/D25).

STEWARD_ORG_SHORT_NAME.meaning: Short display form of the Steward Organization used in prose after first mention.

STEWARD_REGISTRY_URL.blockedBy: OPEN-02 (naming) — the apex domain purposesource.org is owned; the path is a build decision
STEWARD_REGISTRY_URL.meaning: Canonical steward registry URL that appears on the Purpose Notice line (GH-009).

LICENSE_ID.blockedBy: OPEN-20 (final canonical identifier string, pending D4/OPEN-02); SPDX listing is separately "requested" at launch (LEG-029)
LICENSE_ID.meaning: SPDX-style identifier on the Purpose Notice line (GH-009). Must grep uniquely (VS-06).

LICENSE_TEXT_URL.blockedBy: OPEN-20 + the website build (VS-12: the byte-exact .txt endpoint must hash-match the canonical file in this repository)

GITHUB_ORG.blockedBy: none — the organization exists (confirmed 2026-09-08). Superseded: "D4 / OPEN-02 — the org name is proposed, not confirmed"
GITHUB_ORG.meaning: GitHub organization that hosts this repository and the registry repositories.
GITHUB_ORG.note: A settled token stays declared here because README.md still writes it as {{GITHUB_ORG}} and the inventory must account for every token the texts use — removing it would fail the gate, not tidy it. The steward organization's LEGAL name is a different token (STEWARD_ORG_LEGAL_NAME) and is still pending on D4.
